title: Kotta node provenance
description: The 'provenance' block of a specification node's frontmatter: whether its content was stated, partly inferred or inferred, and who decided it. Optional on an accepted node, required on a node a change proposes under openspec/changes/<name>/model/.

quote.description: At most 30 words; the speaker and a timestamp when it comes from a conversation.

inferred.description: What had to be supplied; required when level is not 'stated'.
